report.title: The reference held. The fourth band did not.
paragraphs: A three-second maximum-effort contraction now establishes the individual reference. The firmware filters and squares the EMG signal, applies Kalman filtering, assigns each sample to one of four relative bands, then reports each band as a percentage of the recorded session.

One limitation surfaced: every value above the reference collapses into the highest band. The next experiment is to determine when sustained above-reference activity is meaningful enough to trigger recalibration.

The measurement layer is working. The interface still has to explain the distribution without presenting relative activation as mechanical force—or turning an unfinished interpretation into a recommendation.
report.signature: Sending the next trace after calibration. — Alina
